# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `hangar config reference`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Hangar reads its configuration from a YAML file (`hangar server --config hangar.yaml`, or the `HANGAR_CONFIG` environment variable), then from `HANGAR_*` environment variables, then from `--set key=value` flags. Later sources win. Hangar checks the whole configuration on start and reports every problem at once.

Every key is also an environment variable: `storage.s3.bucket` is `HANGAR_STORAGE_S3_BUCKET`. List values in environment variables and flags are comma-separated. `oidc.providers` takes a JSON array.

Sizes accept a number of bytes or a unit such as `KiB`, `MiB`, `GiB` or `GB`. Durations use Go syntax, such as `90s`, `30m` or `720h`.

## `server`

HTTP server and process settings.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `server.public_url`<br>`HANGAR_SERVER_PUBLIC_URL` | string | `""` | The URL clients use to reach Hangar. Required. Used in redirects, LFS links and git URLs. |
| `server.listen`<br>`HANGAR_SERVER_LISTEN` | string | `:8080` | Address to listen on for HTTP. |
| `server.role`<br>`HANGAR_SERVER_ROLE` | string | `all` | Process role: all, web or worker. SQLite needs all. |
| `server.data_dir`<br>`HANGAR_SERVER_DATA_DIR` | string | `/var/lib/hangar` | Directory for local state: the SQLite lock file and the generated secrets.yaml. |
| `server.trusted_proxies`<br>`HANGAR_SERVER_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | list of strings | `[]` | CIDR ranges of reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For and X-Forwarded-Proto headers Hangar trusts. |
| `server.max_request_body`<br>`HANGAR_SERVER_MAX_REQUEST_BODY` | size | `64MiB` | Body size limit for endpoints that buffer the request body. Streaming endpoints have no limit apart from quotas. |
| `server.shutdown_timeout`<br>`HANGAR_SERVER_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT` | duration | `30s` | How long to let in-flight requests finish on SIGTERM. Longer downloads are cut. |
| `server.timezone`<br>`HANGAR_SERVER_TIMEZONE` | string | `UTC` | IANA time zone for pull windows and schedules. |

## `database`

Database connection.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `database.driver`<br>`HANGAR_DATABASE_DRIVER` | string | `sqlite` | sqlite or postgres. |
| `database.dsn`<br>`HANGAR_DATABASE_DSN` | string | `/var/lib/hangar/hangar.db` | SQLite file path, or a postgres:// connection URL. |
| `database.max_open_conns`<br>`HANGAR_DATABASE_MAX_OPEN_CONNS` | int | `20` | Maximum open database connections per process. |

## `storage`

Blob store for LFS objects, git data and uploads.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storage.backend`<br>`HANGAR_STORAGE_BACKEND` | string | `fs` | fs or s3. |
| `storage.fs.path`<br>`HANGAR_STORAGE_FS_PATH` | string | `/var/lib/hangar/blobs` | Root directory of the Blob store. |
| `storage.s3.endpoint`<br>`HANGAR_STORAGE_S3_ENDPOINT` | string | `s3.amazonaws.com` | S3 endpoint host, with an optional port. Use https:// or http:// to choose the scheme; the default is HTTPS. |
| `storage.s3.region`<br>`HANGAR_STORAGE_S3_REGION` | string | `eu-west-2` | Bucket region. |
| `storage.s3.bucket`<br>`HANGAR_STORAGE_S3_BUCKET` | string | `hangar` | Bucket name. |
| `storage.s3.prefix`<br>`HANGAR_STORAGE_S3_PREFIX` | string | `""` | Key prefix inside the bucket. |
| `storage.s3.access_key_id`<br>`HANGAR_STORAGE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | string | `""` | Access key ID. Leave empty to use the default credential chain, IRSA or Workload Identity. |
| `storage.s3.secret_access_key`<br>`HANGAR_STORAGE_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | string | `""` | Secret access key. |
| `storage.s3.use_path_style`<br>`HANGAR_STORAGE_S3_USE_PATH_STYLE` | bool | `false` | Use path-style bucket addressing, as MinIO and some other stores need. |
| `storage.s3.download_mode`<br>`HANGAR_STORAGE_S3_DOWNLOAD_MODE` | string | `redirect` | redirect sends clients to presigned URLs; proxy streams bytes through Hangar. |
| `storage.s3.upload_mode`<br>`HANGAR_STORAGE_S3_UPLOAD_MODE` | string | `direct` | direct gives clients presigned URLs to upload LFS objects and parts to the store; proxy has them upload through Hangar. Use proxy when clients cannot reach the endpoint. |
| `storage.s3.presign_ttl`<br>`HANGAR_STORAGE_S3_PRESIGN_TTL` | duration | `1h` | Lifetime of presigned download URLs. |

## `security`

Secrets, sign-in and access defaults.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `security.instance_key`<br>`HANGAR_SECURITY_INSTANCE_KEY` | string | `""` | 32-byte key, base64-encoded, that encrypts stored secrets and signs URLs. Generated on first start if empty. |
| `security.anonymous_read`<br>`HANGAR_SECURITY_ANONYMOUS_READ` | bool | `false` | Let anonymous users read public Repos. |
| `security.registration`<br>`HANGAR_SECURITY_REGISTRATION` | string | `closed` | Who can create an account: open, invite or closed. |
| `security.local_login`<br>`HANGAR_SECURITY_LOCAL_LOGIN` | bool | `true` | Show the username and password form. The bootstrap admin can always sign in at /auth/login?local=1. |
| `security.session_ttl`<br>`HANGAR_SECURITY_SESSION_TTL` | duration | `720h` | Lifetime of a UI session. |
| `security.bootstrap_admin.username`<br>`HANGAR_SECURITY_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME` | string | `hangar-admin` | Username of the bootstrap admin. |
| `security.bootstrap_admin.password`<br>`HANGAR_SECURITY_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | string | `""` | Password of the bootstrap admin. Generated on first start if empty and no password_file is set. |
| `security.bootstrap_admin.password_file`<br>`HANGAR_SECURITY_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD_FILE` | string | `""` | File that holds the bootstrap admin password. |
| `security.bootstrap_admin.email`<br>`HANGAR_SECURITY_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL` | string | `""` | Email address of the bootstrap admin. |

## `oidc`

OpenID Connect sign-in providers.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `oidc.providers`<br>`HANGAR_OIDC_PROVIDERS` | list of objects | `[]` | Providers, shown as sign-in buttons. Set them in the YAML file, or as a JSON array in HANGAR_OIDC_PROVIDERS. |
| `oidc.providers[].id` | string |  | Stable provider ID, used in callback URLs. |
| `oidc.providers[].name` | string |  | Name on the sign-in button. |
| `oidc.providers[].issuer` | string |  | Issuer URL, used for discovery. |
| `oidc.providers[].client_id` | string |  | OAuth client ID. |
| `oidc.providers[].client_secret` | string | `(secret)` | OAuth client secret. Leave empty for public clients. |
| `oidc.providers[].scopes` | list of strings |  | Scopes to request. |
| `oidc.providers[].claims` | map of strings |  | Claim names for username, email, name and groups. |
| `oidc.providers[].admin_groups` | list of strings |  | Members of these groups are Instance admins. Checked at every sign-in. |
| `oidc.providers[].org_mappings` | list of objects |  | Groups that grant Organisation Roles. Checked at every sign-in. |
| `oidc.providers[].org_mappings[].group` | string |  | Group claim value. |
| `oidc.providers[].org_mappings[].org` | string |  | Organisation name. |
| `oidc.providers[].org_mappings[].role` | string |  | read, write or admin. |
| `oidc.providers[].auto_create_users` | bool |  | Create a User on first sign-in. |

## `upstreams`

Upstreams that Hangar can Pull from, keyed by ID. huggingface is built in.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `upstreams.<id>.base_url`<br>`HANGAR_UPSTREAMS_<ID>_BASE_URL` | string | `https://huggingface.co` | Base URL of the Upstream's Hub API. |
| `upstreams.<id>.enabled`<br>`HANGAR_UPSTREAMS_<ID>_ENABLED` | bool | `true` | Whether users can Discover and Pull from this Upstream. |
| `upstreams.<id>.token`<br>`HANGAR_UPSTREAMS_<ID>_TOKEN` | string | `""` | Optional Instance token, used when the requesting user has not saved their own. |
| `upstreams.<id>.namespace_prefix`<br>`HANGAR_UPSTREAMS_<ID>_NAMESPACE_PREFIX` | string | `""` | Prefix for Mirror Namespaces from this Upstream, for example hf-. Prefixed Mirrors no longer work as drop-in HF_ENDPOINT replacements. |
| `upstreams.<id>.viewer_url`<br>`HANGAR_UPSTREAMS_<ID>_VIEWER_URL` | string | `""` | Dataset Viewer URL of the Upstream. Default: the base URL with datasets-server. added to the host. |

## `pull`

Pull scheduling and network controls.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pull.bandwidth_limit`<br>`HANGAR_PULL_BANDWIDTH_LIMIT` | size | `0` | Bytes per second across the Instance. 0 means unlimited. |
| `pull.concurrency`<br>`HANGAR_PULL_CONCURRENCY` | int | `4` | Files transferred at once across the Instance. |
| `pull.windows`<br>`HANGAR_PULL_WINDOWS` | list of strings | `[]` | Times when Pull transfers may run, such as 01:00-07:00, in server.timezone. Empty means any time. |
| `pull.pull_through.enabled`<br>`HANGAR_PULL_PULL_THROUGH_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | Turn on Pull-through. |
| `pull.pull_through.allow`<br>`HANGAR_PULL_PULL_THROUGH_ALLOW` | list of strings | `[*]` | Globs of upstream Repo IDs that may be pulled through. |
| `pull.pull_through.min_role`<br>`HANGAR_PULL_PULL_THROUGH_MIN_ROLE` | string | `user` | Who may trigger Pull-through: anonymous or user (any signed-in user). |
| `pull.dependencies.auto_pull_code`<br>`HANGAR_PULL_DEPENDENCIES_AUTO_PULL_CODE` | bool | `true` | Pull code Dependencies (from auto_map) automatically. |
| `pull.dependencies.auto_pull_base_models`<br>`HANGAR_PULL_DEPENDENCIES_AUTO_PULL_BASE_MODELS` | bool | `false` | Pull the base model of adapters automatically. |
| `pull.dependencies.max_depth`<br>`HANGAR_PULL_DEPENDENCIES_MAX_DEPTH` | int | `5` | Maximum depth of recursive Dependency Pulls. |

## `git`

git storage, push limits and the local pack cache.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `git.max_blob_size`<br>`HANGAR_GIT_MAX_BLOB_SIZE` | size | `10MiB` | Largest non-LFS file accepted on push. |
| `git.max_pack_size`<br>`HANGAR_GIT_MAX_PACK_SIZE` | size | `2GiB` | Largest pack accepted on push. |
| `git.allow_force_push`<br>`HANGAR_GIT_ALLOW_FORCE_PUSH` | bool | `false` | Allow force-pushing default branches. Namespace admins always can. |
| `git.compact_threshold`<br>`HANGAR_GIT_COMPACT_THRESHOLD` | int | `20` | Compact a Repo's packs when it has more live packs than this. |
| `git.pack_grace_period`<br>`HANGAR_GIT_PACK_GRACE_PERIOD` | duration | `1h` | How long retired packs are kept before deletion. Must be longer than the longest request. |
| `git.cache_dir`<br>`HANGAR_GIT_CACHE_DIR` | string | `/var/cache/hangar/git` | Local pack cache directory. Disposable. |
| `git.cache_size`<br>`HANGAR_GIT_CACHE_SIZE` | size | `10GiB` | Size limit of the local pack cache. |
| `git.timeout`<br>`HANGAR_GIT_TIMEOUT` | duration | `1h` | Wall-clock limit for one git operation. |

## `lfs`

git-lfs uploads.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lfs.multipart_threshold`<br>`HANGAR_LFS_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD` | size | `64MiB` | Objects larger than this use multipart uploads when the client supports them. |
| `lfs.upload_url_ttl`<br>`HANGAR_LFS_UPLOAD_URL_TTL` | duration | `24h` | Lifetime of signed upload URLs. |
| `lfs.verify_wait`<br>`HANGAR_LFS_VERIFY_WAIT` | duration | `10m` | How long a Commit waits for an LFS object that is still being verified. |

## `hfapi`

Hugging Face Hub API behaviour.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hfapi.regular_upload_max`<br>`HANGAR_HFAPI_REGULAR_UPLOAD_MAX` | size | `10MiB` | Preupload answers regular for files below this size unless .gitattributes says LFS. |
| `hfapi.xet`<br>`HANGAR_HFAPI_XET` | string | `ingest` | ingest accepts Xet uploads; reject turns them off and asks clients to set HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1. |
| `hfapi.default_namespace`<br>`HANGAR_HFAPI_DEFAULT_NAMESPACE` | string | `""` | Namespace that single-segment Repo IDs such as gpt2 redirect to. Empty turns the redirect off. |

## `xet`

Xet upload ingestion.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xet.cas_url`<br>`HANGAR_XET_CAS_URL` | string | `""` | URL of the Xet CAS endpoints. Default: <public_url>/xet-cas. |
| `xet.token_ttl`<br>`HANGAR_XET_TOKEN_TTL` | duration | `1h` | Lifetime of Xet write tokens. |
| `xet.xorb_retention`<br>`HANGAR_XET_XORB_RETENTION` | duration | `672h` | How long xorbs are kept after their last use, so clients can deduplicate against them. Keep it longer than hf_xet's 21-day shard cache. |
| `xet.max_file_size`<br>`HANGAR_XET_MAX_FILE_SIZE` | size | `50GiB` | Largest file a Xet upload may describe. One shard may rebuild at most four times this, counting only files not uploaded before; larger uploads get 413. |

## `jobs`

Background Job workers.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jobs.workers`<br>`HANGAR_JOBS_WORKERS` | int | `4` | Concurrent Jobs per worker process. |
| `jobs.lease`<br>`HANGAR_JOBS_LEASE` | duration | `1m` | Lease length of a claimed Job. Renewed while the Job runs. |

## `gc`

Garbage collection of unreferenced LFS objects and git data.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gc.schedule`<br>`HANGAR_GC_SCHEDULE` | string | `0 3 * * *` | Cron schedule (5 fields) of the gc Job. |
| `gc.grace_period`<br>`HANGAR_GC_GRACE_PERIOD` | duration | `168h` | Unreferenced LFS objects are deleted after this long. |

## `repos`

Repo lifecycle.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `repos.restore_window`<br>`HANGAR_REPOS_RESTORE_WINDOW` | duration | `168h` | How long a deleted Repo can be restored before it is purged. |

## `viewer`

Dataset Viewer and Parquet export.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `viewer.enabled`<br>`HANGAR_VIEWER_ENABLED` | bool | `true` | Turn on Parquet export and the Dataset Viewer. |
| `viewer.max_convert_bytes`<br>`HANGAR_VIEWER_MAX_CONVERT_BYTES` | size | `5GiB` | Splits larger than this get a partial Parquet export. |
| `viewer.max_scan_rows`<br>`HANGAR_VIEWER_MAX_SCAN_ROWS` | int | `5000000` | Rows scanned by one filter or search request before it returns partial results. |
| `viewer.max_scan_seconds`<br>`HANGAR_VIEWER_MAX_SCAN_SECONDS` | duration | `10s` | Time limit of one filter or search request before it returns partial results. |
| `viewer.max_cell_bytes`<br>`HANGAR_VIEWER_MAX_CELL_BYTES` | size | `100KiB` | Cells larger than this are truncated in Viewer responses. |
| `viewer.max_request_bytes`<br>`HANGAR_VIEWER_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES` | size | `300000000` | Decoded Parquet data one Dataset Viewer request may hold; requests that need more answer with an error, as the Hub's do. |
| `viewer.convert_concurrency`<br>`HANGAR_VIEWER_CONVERT_CONCURRENCY` | int | `1` | dataset.convert Jobs per worker. |

## `telemetry`

OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs. Standard OTEL_* variables also apply and win.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `telemetry.service_name`<br>`HANGAR_TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME` | string | `hangar` | service.name resource attribute. |
| `telemetry.environment`<br>`HANGAR_TELEMETRY_ENVIRONMENT` | string | `""` | deployment.environment.name resource attribute. Empty leaves it unset. |
| `telemetry.traces`<br>`HANGAR_TELEMETRY_TRACES` | string | `otlp` | Trace exporter: otlp, console or none. otlp exports only when an OTLP endpoint is set with OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT or OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT. Ignored when OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER is set. |
| `telemetry.metrics`<br>`HANGAR_TELEMETRY_METRICS` | string | `otlp` | Metric exporter: otlp, prometheus, console or none. otlp exports only when an OTLP endpoint is set. Ignored when OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER is set. |
| `telemetry.logs`<br>`HANGAR_TELEMETRY_LOGS` | string | `otlp` | Log exporter: otlp, console or none. otlp exports only when an OTLP endpoint is set. Ignored when OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER is set. Logs always go to stdout too. |
| `telemetry.prometheus_listen`<br>`HANGAR_TELEMETRY_PROMETHEUS_LISTEN` | string | `:9464` | Address of the Prometheus /metrics endpoint when metrics is prometheus. |
| `telemetry.log_format`<br>`HANGAR_TELEMETRY_LOG_FORMAT` | string | `json` | Stdout log format: json or text. |
| `telemetry.log_level`<br>`HANGAR_TELEMETRY_LOG_LEVEL` | string | `info` | Minimum log level: debug, info, warn or error. |
